messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Meera Patel <meera.patel@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2029-09-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + PO split (Atlas Health)

Hi Meera / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Atlas Health's renewal is coming up (RDW-3921) and we wanted to propose a small onboarding refresh and a split PO approach to make the procurement path smoother on your side. High level: 12‑month term extension, +20% seat/capacity uplift, and two-part PO (50% initial, 50% on 2029-12-01) to align with your budget cycle.

What we need from you to keep the timeline moving:
- Confirmation that the split PO is acceptable to procurement.
- Vendor portal upload: Redwood vendor code + W9 (we can provide vendor metadata).
- SOC 2 and KMS/HSM details: Meera flagged this in our call. See attached evidence bundle for SOC2 report & encryption notes.

I've attached a short procurement checklist and a draft amendment (signed-amendment-draft.docx) with the proposed term and capacity lines for legal to redline. If procurement prefers, we can create two POs with the exact invoice schedule.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm portal requirements and whether a staged PO is OK (meera/procurement).
2) If yes, procurement sends the PO numbers and we begin portal upload (Redwood team: Laura + Marcus to support).
3) Legal redline of the amendment (Hannah to coordinate).

Happy to hop on a 20‑minute call this week to finalize.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx (stub), redwood-evidence-bundle-0928.pdf (stub), signed-amendment-draft.docx (stub)

From: Meera Patel <meera.patel@atlashealth.com>

Date: 2029-09-18T11:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + PO split (Atlas Health)

Hi Avery,

Thanks — the proposal sounds reasonable. A few quick items from procurement and infosec so we can avoid back-and-forth:

- Procurement: split PO is acceptable if the vendor can invoice on the two milestone dates. We need vendor bank details and Redwood's vendor code when you upload. Also please include Redwood's W9.
- Infosec: SOC 2 Type II is required; we also need a brief note (1 paragraph) about how customer data is isolated and whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations. The evidence bundle you attached looks close but can you provide a KMS summary?
- Contract: we may need a short redline from your legal team on the amendment. Our legal turnaround is ~3 business days once we get your redline.

Can you upload the vendor metadata and the KMS summary to our procurement portal (portal.atlashealth.com/vendor-upload) and share the vendor code once created? If possible, can Laura or Marcus handle the portal upload?

I'll loop Ben from procurement for the PO issuance cadence. If we can finish portal upload by 2029-09-20 and get a redline by 2029-09-22, procurement can issue the initial PO the week of 2029-09-23.

Appreciate it — Meera
Meera Patel
Head of Vendor Relations | Atlas Health
meera.patel@atlashealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up after your uploads and then loop Meera/Ben for PO details.

— Avery

- We will issue two POs as requested: PO# AH-2029-5501 (50% initial) and PO# AH-2029-5502 (50% due 2029-12-01).
